title: The Coherence-Delay Trade-off and Coercive Masking Under Drift
description: LaTeX source and experiment code for the v2 preprint 'The Coherence-Delay Trade-off and Coercive Masking Under Drift: Finite-Memory Tracking Limits and Effort-Aware Diagnostics'. Earlier drafts circulated under the title 'The Coherence-Delay Trade-off in Tracking Under Drift: A Cube-Root Law for Finite-Memory Estimation'.
